SSE is the standard for streaming data from server to client over HTTP.
Server pushes the update to the client


Built a real-time news stream processing engine supporting infinite publisher streams, windowed aggregations, compile-once transformations, SSE delivery, and backpressure-aware async pipelines.


Real-Time News Stream Processing Engine”
That gives you:

continuous event streams
windows
transforms
fanout
prioritization
backpressure
infinite producers

without sounding like observability/log infrastructure.

Why News Works Well

News naturally behaves like streaming events.

Example event:

{
  "source": "Reuters",
  "category": "technology",
  "headline": "AI chip demand rises",
  "timestamp": ...
}

You can simulate:

multiple publishers
breaking news bursts
category subscriptions
rolling trends
live feeds

Very realistic for stream systems.

Mapping from Log Concepts → News Concepts
Streaming System Concept	News Equivalent
log event	news article
producer	publisher
severity	priority
stream	live feed
aggregation	trend analysis
alerts	breaking news
fanout	subscribers
filtering	topic/category filters
Your Architecture Becomes
News Publishers
       ↓
Ingress Queue
       ↓
Normalizer
       ↓
Transform Engine
       ↓
Window Aggregator
       ↓
Subscriber Queues
       ↓
SSE Clients

Looks clean and product-oriented.
Infinite Loop Producers
Each publisher continuously emits articles:

while running:
    article = generate_news()
    await ingress_queue.put(article)
